name: aleogr
description: Personal marketplace: the aleogr orchestrator and its family plugins.

plugins.name: aleogr
plugins.description: Orchestrator: checks tools and plans and creates the shared platform (shared project, budget alert and the shared Cloud SQL database with its night switch), and declares, plans and applies a project's GitHub repository, proposes a change to it by pull request, generates its Go components and CI file, and makes the check ci required once that file is merged.

plugins.name: aleogr-cloud-gcp
plugins.description: Google Cloud family: project environments, services and budget alerts.

plugins.name: aleogr-db-gcp-cloud-sql
plugins.description: Cloud SQL family: the shared platform's PostgreSQL instance and its start and stop.

plugins.name: aleogr-registry-gcp-artifact-registry
plugins.description: Artifact Registry family: a project's Docker image repository in its own Google Cloud project.

plugins.name: aleogr-repo-github
plugins.description: GitHub family: repositories, their settings, branch protection, the checkout that sends the first content, and the pull requests that propose changes.

plugins.name: aleogr-stack-go
plugins.description: Go stack: the starting point of a Go component.
